scope: Deterministic visual tracers and chamber confinement, not CFD, molecular dynamics or cylinder thermodynamics

checks.name: All tracer centers remain inside four moving chambers over a full turn
Rod-side particles never intersect the piston rod
All particle coordinates, sizes and opacities remain finite
Minimum chamber height respects the original clearance
Identical angle and time reproduce the same cloud
A paused clock freezes every particle
Admission travels away from the upper head
Exhaust reverses towards the same upper head
A cold simulation can clear all cloud opacity
Default quality uses a bounded 384-puff budget

browser_checks.name: Four default clouds render in actual cylinders
Default GPU budget is 384 instanced puffs
Shader clips puff edges against both cylinder walls and piston faces
Puffs and wisps animate with the explanatory cycle
Pause freezes cloud geometry and shader time
Cloud boundaries follow both faces of the moving piston
The same chamber admits then exhausts
Flow tracer mode remains available
Steam visibility can be switched off
The existing fluid-layer switch also hides steam
A cold stopped simulation does not invent steam
Simulated steam appears when calculated flow starts
Simulation pause freezes the steam clock
Cloud shader respects opaque metal depth
Existing section planes reach every cloud
Temperature view retains the thermodynamic colors
Cloud rendering works in fullscreen
Mobile initial load uses 192 puffs
Steam controls fit a mobile viewport
No shader or browser errors
